Maya (CSM): Quick heads-up: SentryBridge private deployment is failing KMS Encrypt with AccessDenied this morning. Customer is concerned about timeline and we've flagged an elevated renewal risk if this isn't resolved within 10 days. Can @Ravi or @Ana triage?
Ravi (Infra): Can you paste the exact AWS error and the role ARN? Also confirm whether they use NAT egress or a KMS VPC endpoint.
Maya (CSM): Customer pasted: `ClientError: An error occurred (AccessDeniedException) when calling the Encrypt operation: User is not authorized to perform kms:Encrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/7a1b2c3d` Role: `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/sentrybridge-app-Role` They told us egress goes through the managed NAT gateway; no KMS endpoint configured.
Ana (Security): Typical pattern: key policy includes aws:SourceIp or aws:SourceVpc conditions. With SNAT via NAT, outgoing IPs don't match the original pod IPs — so aws:SourceIp fails. Two remediation paths: allow the role principal in key policy (tight, temporary) OR create a KMS Interface VPC endpoint so SourceVpc condition can pass.
Ethan (Solutions): Quick mitigation we used with another customer: provision an Interface endpoint for KMS in two subnets and attach a small SG that permits the app ENIs. Command example: `aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id vpc-0abc --service-name com.amazonaws.us-west-2.kms --vpc-endpoint-type Interface --subnet-ids subnet-1,subnet-2 --security-group-ids sg-aaa111` This bypasses SNAT and satisfies aws:SourceVpc.
Maya (CSM): Customer said they cannot add endpoints without infra approval and subnet quotas might be tight. They asked if a temporary key-policy change is acceptable while infra queues the endpoint.
Ana (Security): We can add a scoped policy statement allowing only kms:Encrypt/kms:Decrypt for that role and log the change. Must include an expiration/rollback plan. I'll draft the minimal statement and an audit checklist.
Ravi (Infra): If they prefer not to touch KMS policy, another option: create a small dedicated NAT with allocated Elastic IPs used only for SentryBridge traffic. Then we can whitelist the NAT egress IPs in the key policy condition `aws:SourceIp`. That's reversible but requires provisioning. I'll check capacity and lead time.
Maya (CSM): Splunk forwarder note from the customer: their audit logs show truncated requestParameters for KMS calls when proxied. Any gotchas?
Ethan (Solutions): Splunk UF sometimes drops body fields when using certain HTTP inputs or proxies. Ask them to enable full request body capture for the KMS agent and to run a single `aws kms encrypt` from a jump host in the VPC and forward that raw event to Splunk for correlation. Also check UF config: `/opt/splunkforwarder/etc/system/local/inputs.conf` and ensure `followTail` and `truncate` settings aren't truncating the payload.
Ana (Security): Also request CloudTrail data events for KMS for the window — CloudTrail is authoritative and will show principal, keyId, and sourceIp. Attach that export before our call.
Maya (CSM): Proposed actions: 1) Ravi: feasibility for KMS VPC endpoint (subnets/SGs) or dedicated NAT alternative (owner: Ravi). 2) Ana: minimal key-policy snippet for temporary allow + rollback plan and required audit entries (owner: Ana). 3) Ethan: Splunk forwarder troubleshooting checklist + test steps (owner: Ethan). 4) Maya: schedule a 30m runbook review call with customer — target Tue 09:00 PT.
Ravi (Infra): I'll check subnet availability and quota; will post an endpoint plan by EOD with expected ETA. If endpoint isn't feasible quickly, I'll include NAT provisioning estimate.
Ana (Security): Draft policy example (to be tightened to specific key ARN): `{"Sid":"TempAllowSentryBridgeRole","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/sentrybridge-app-Role"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/7a1b2c3d"}` We'll include an access-approval log and set a scheduled task to remove in 72 hours or when endpoint is validated.
Ethan (Solutions): Splunk checklist highlights: enable raw payload for the UF input, confirm forwarder version >=8.x, disable any intermediate HTTP proxies for the test, and capture a CLI-run encrypt event for comparison. I'll attach a short `inputs.conf` snippet in the call.
